key.name: capture-area
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts the area selection.

key.name: flash
key.description: Briefly flash the captured region as visual confirmation.

key.name: shutter-sound
key.description: Play the system screen-capture sound after a capture.

key.name: dim-background
key.summary: Dim the area outside the selection
key.description: Darken everything except the region currently being selected.

key.name: show-size
key.description: Display the pixel dimensions of the selection while dragging.
